title: VPN disconnects every 20 minutes
description: My VPN connects but drops every 20 minutes with an IKEv2 error and I have to reconnect. I'm working from home today.

title: IP address conflict on office laptop
description: Windows says Windows has detected an IP address conflict whenever I dock at my desk and I lose network access for a few minutes.

title: Month-end report fails with ORA-01652
description: The month-end finance report fails with ORA-01652 unable to extend temp segment. About 20 people in Finance are waiting for it and the close is blocked.

title: Deadlocks in order service
description: The order service log shows ERROR 1213 (40001): Deadlock found when trying to get lock a few times an hour. Orders are retried but some fail.

title: Laptop plugged in, not charging
description: My laptop battery icon shows Plugged in, not charging and the laptop dies within an hour when I unplug it.

title: Print jobs stuck, printer offline
description: My print jobs are stuck in the queue and the 2nd floor printer shows Printer offline on my laptop. Colleagues can print.

title: Teams cannot find microphone
description: In Teams meetings I get We can't find a microphone although my headset works for music.

title: Windows update fails with 0x80070002
description: The Windows update keeps failing with 0x80070002 and asks to retry every day.

title: MFA push approval times out
description: I don't get the MFA push on my phone and the sign-in page says Approval request timed out.

title: Replied to fake CEO gift card email
description: I got an urgent email from our CEO asking me to buy gift cards and send the codes. I replied before noticing the sender address was external.

title: Security intelligence update failed
description: Endpoint protection says Security intelligence update failed and the definitions are three days old.

title: Leave portal HTTP 503 for HR
description: The leave management portal shows HTTP 503 Service Unavailable for everyone in HR since 9 am. Payroll cut-off is today.
